_doc: Shot type and picture from the brief rev 10 shot list, for review overlays. B01 and N31a-c split per the M1 cue plan.

B01.picture: Zoom out from the newsreel to the planning chat (moved from the opening)

N02.picture: Iris opens on a cathedral radio in a parlor; a family leans in. Slow push to the radio

N04.picture: Barbershop: the barber, razor raised, leans to whisper. Push in

N06.picture: The thinking machine (brass cabinet, one bulb) wheeled past the window on a hand truck. Pan

N07.picture: A wall of hand-drawn charts, every line pointing up off the paper. Pan up

N08.picture: Card, then the man in the chair signing a margin slip, lather on his face

N09.picture: Dance hall: couples doing the Charleston

N10.picture: Ticker tape streaming down from above

N11.picture: Skyline with one building far taller than the rest. Tilt up

N13.picture: The crumpled dollar passed hand to hand

N14.picture: Night cornfield; a windowless building glows. Slow pan

N15.picture: Same frame; a dissolve adds a power plant with smokestacks beside it

N16.picture: Push through three nested office doors, each smaller (zoom between three stills)

N17.picture: Hatbox on a desk, overflowing with IOU slips

N18.picture: Dance hall faster, cut on every bar; tape

N19.picture: Freeze frame of a C1 dancer

N22.picture: One-frame insert: a dancer in modern clothes

N23.picture: Silhouette band: clarinet and trumpet trading, a kick line below

N24.picture: Banker at a big rate dial; the needle climbs (K overlay)

N26.picture: Man proudly holding a rising sales chart; banknotes stream from his back pocket

N27.picture: Same man, pie in the face. Hard cut on the beat

N30.picture: Freeze mid-kick, then film burn to black

N32.picture: Iris opens on a crooner with a megaphone at a piano, one spotlight, empty hall knee-deep in tape. Slow pull back
